cards.title: Signal path

items: inProj: Y = X*W^T, W:[2304x768], split Y into Q,K,V
Attention: A = softmax(QK^T/sqrt64)*V, O(S^2*64/head)
outProj: Y = X*W^T, W:[768x768]
LayerNorm: y = g*(x-u)/s + b, residual add first
Pooler/cls: h = tanh(Wp*x+b); logits = Wc*h (2-way, 3 for MNLI)
Codec: duration-encode rows to col currents, 7-bit OLP digitize
Drift/HWA: G(t) = G0*(t/t0)^-nu + noise*scale
Island Q8.8 <-> tile int8: s8<<8 in, requant out (PARAMS §2)
